reason: The modify_pending_order_items tool and policy's 'Modify items' section only support changing each listed item to a different option of the same product (item_ids and new_item_ids must be positionally matched, same product, different option). The candidate call passes new_item_ids as an empty list while item_ids lists three items to be removed entirely, which is an outright deletion of items, not a same-product option swap. Policy provides no procedure for removing items from a pending order without replacement; that action can only be accomplished via order cancellation (order-level) or return (delivered orders only), neither of which applies to a pending, partially-desired order. Therefore this call does not match any authorized action shape and must be blocked.
policy_references: For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option.
Each new item id should match the item id in the same position and be of the same product.
Generally, you can only take action on pending or delivered orders.
